summary: 29-year-old solo backcountry snowboarder caught, buried under ~6 ft of debris and killed in an avalanche south of Trout Lake.
location: South of Trout Lake, ~13 miles south of Telluride (~5 miles SW of Ophir), North San Juan zone
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff; San Miguel County Search and Rescue; Helitrax (heli-ski operator)
notes: Devin Overton, 29, of Telluride; Helitrax spotted single tracks entering the slide and did an aerial beacon search, landing to locate the victim; SAR flown in to recover the body; 13th US avalanche death of the winter.
